deadEnd.details: Checkout is a modal account wizard with no guest path. The create-account screen, the sign-in screen and the create-account form that follows the email step all lack any guest control: button:has-text('guest') matches only a hidden invite-guests button in the bag, and a:has-text('guest') and [data-testid*='guest' i] count 0 on every screen. The only exits are an account by email and password or a social sign-in, so there is no contact form, no delivery details page and no card surface for an unattended run. There is also no checkout page, since a direct visit to /checkout is a 404.

gotchas: The site is address first. Click input[data-testid=address-input], type the street, wait about 4 seconds and click the single [role=option] suggestion. The listing at /lets-eat then shows restaurant tiles and the header shows the street. No city, state or zip fields exist, and the street alone was enough.

Add an item from the item modal, not from the card's quick-add button, which an earlier drive clicked with no bag change. Click the menu card to open the modal, use its footer button, then check the bag badge.

Proceed to Checkout is a modal rather than a navigation, so judge progress by the inputs inside [data-testid='modal-root'] and never by the URL. At a desktop width the first click swaps the bag popover for an upsell panel whose own button keeps the same id, so it takes two clicks; at a narrower width one Enter on #ghs-cart-checkout-button opened the wizard while a plain click timed out every time.
A match for text containing guest is not proof of a guest path. Here it was a hidden invite-guests button in the bag, so check the match's data-testid before clicking it.

Locally the wizard's email step redirects to a page reading Access to this page has been blocked with a human-verification iframe. That is a wall rather than a form, and it was not reached from the proxy egress.
Several clicks reported a timeout after the action had already taken effect, so re-check state by count before retrying a step.
notes: Driven through the Agent Vault proxy in September 2026 as far as the account wizard: address autocomplete, restaurant page, item modal, add to bag, the bag popover and Proceed to Checkout all worked, and the wizard's email step led to a create-account form asking for a first name, last name and password. That is where the route ends. Stripe.js loads on every page but the only payment-related frame is its metrics iframe, which holds no inputs, so the card surface is unknown.
